2. Draw a thin red border rectangle inset slightly from slide edges.
3. Add a white rounded rectangle at top-left inside the border; type 'Chess' in red italic serif, then newline 'Generated by "for loops"' in blue sans-serif.
4. Add a yellow circle at top-right inside the border with black number '41'.
5. Insert a scatter plot panel occupying center-right with white background; set x and y axes 0â25 with major gridlines at 0,5,10,15,20,25.
6. Place red and blue dots at the integer coordinates listed above; use red #D82A2A and blue #2A57D8.
7. Add black axis tick labels 0,5,10,15,20,25 on both axes.
8. Ensure no extra text or bullets are added beyond what is transcribed.
